title: Performance Test Engineer
summary: Performance test engineers check how fast and stable an application stays when many users use it at once, by simulating load and finding what slows it down. They sit in the QA or quality engineering team and work with developers and infrastructure teams to fix bottlenecks before release.
dailyDuties: Agree performance requirements and workload models with business and IT teams
Script user journeys in JMeter, LoadRunner, Gatling or k6
Run load, stress and endurance tests
Monitor servers and applications with APM tools during tests
Analyse slow queries, thread dumps and heap dumps to find bottlenecks
Write test reports with findings and tuning suggestions

skills.expectation: Script and run load, stress and endurance tests in JMeter, LoadRunner, Gatling or k6
Turn non-functional requirements into workload models, test plans and pass criteria
Find bottlenecks during tests with Dynatrace, AppDynamics or New Relic
Analyse CPU, memory, thread and heap dumps to find root causes
Query the database to find slow queries during a test
Understand HTTP requests, sessions and APIs to script realistic user journeys
Write and debug test scripts in Java, JavaScript or Python
Write and debug test scripts in Java, JavaScript or Python
Write and debug test scripts in Java, JavaScript or Python
Present results and tuning advice to developers and business teams
Run performance tests in Jenkins or GitLab pipelines
Use traces to follow slow requests across services

groups.label: A scripting language for load tests (Java, JavaScript or Python)

certifications.why: Common testing baseline in Indian QA hiring
